description: A schema_version no build knows validates against no version's schema, and the semantic validator reports unsupported_schema_version. The case originally used version 2 as its example of 'unsupported', which stopped being true the day version 2 shipped (the `book` component); the number was moved out of reach rather than the expectation being weakened — what this case pins is that an unknown version is refused, not that any particular number is unknown. Pick a still-higher number if 99 is ever real.
